By: Akkash Gogte, Carson Guise, Claudia Zhu, Rose LaDue, Sean Crowley
The Era’s Tour Effect on Ticket Prices

|  2
A Lasting Legacy
▪
Has broken many records with the tour
▪
Wrapped up in 2024
▪
149 tour dates across 51 cities
▪
Has a lasting impact on concert culture, 
especially when it comes to ticket pricing

|  3
SOAR Model
S - Specify the Question 
●
Analyze how Taylor Swift’s Era’s Tour has affected concert ticket pricing
O - Obtain the Data
●
Used Ticketmaster and various other concert databases to find various statistics 
to compare various other artist’s tours
A - Answer the Question
●
Price gouging was at an all time after the start of the Era’s Tour
R - Report the Finding
●
We looked at other big artists, Travis Scott, Coldplay, Tate McRae, Sabrina 
Carpenter, and Charli XCX, and their ticket prices for their tours before and after 
the Era’s Tour
